task: Classify one online shopping support message.

labels.order_status: Ask where an order is or when it will arrive.
labels.cancel_order: Explicitly request cancellation of an order.
labels.refund: Request money back or check an existing refund.
labels.return_replace: Explicitly request a return, exchange, or replacement.
labels.payment_issue: Report a failed, pending, duplicate, or incorrect payment.
labels.account_access: Report trouble logging in, receiving a login OTP, or recovering account access.
labels.update_account: Request changes to profile details, a saved address, or an existing order's delivery address.
labels.product_issue: Report a defective, incorrect, or incomplete product without an explicit return, replacement, or refund request.
labels.delivery_issue: Report a late, failed, wrong-address, or missing delivery.
labels.other: Make an unsupported or insufficiently clear request.

annotation_rules: An explicit requested action takes priority over the problem description.
An arrival-time question is order_status unless the message explicitly reports a delivery problem.
A product complaint with an explicit return, exchange, or replacement request is return_replace.
An explicit request for money back or a refund update is refund.
Changing a known password is update_account; recovering a forgotten password is account_access.
For other examples, record whether the request is unsupported or unclear in annotation notes.
Flag conflicting requests without one clear main intent as ambiguous for human review before assigning a training label.
Reject empty or whitespace-only input before classification.
